summary: Turn customer, product and channel data into banking decisions. Explore the manager-focused course and review its practical curriculum.
lede: Banking analytics connects customer, product and channel measures to portfolio and service decisions. For product, operations, strategy and customer-experience managers, it develops practical ways to frame decision questions, check data quality and interpret segment and channel patterns. Participants work with KPI trees, RFM segmentation and channel scorecards to assess priorities and present evidence-based recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for banking professionals who use customer, product and channel evidence to set priorities, monitor performance or advise decision-makers.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with banking products or operations, plus comfort reading tables, charts and KPI reports. No coding or credit-risk modelling is required.
